title: What do you use to create your character design?
author: Prior-Meeting1645
selftext: I tried gemini and chatgpt, they either look to AI or if given a reference inspiration photo, they basically copy paste it.

comments.author: NuclearStudent
comments.body: I think this is one of those things you shouldn't outsource to AI, actually. AI is fine with a lot of frontend tasks, but on anything "prestige" that the user sees a lot, like character designs or very frequently used interfaces, I wouldn't cheap out.

replies.author: Prior-Meeting1645
replies.body: Fair enough and I would absolutely love to give real designers a job opportunity and pay them but unfortunately I am just starting out with no dev knowledge etc and so want to see how far can I go.

replies.author: NuclearStudent
replies.body:
oh just start by drawing a stick figure, getting a free premade, or purchasing the cheapest model you can from an asset dump

comments.author: soleduo023
comments.body:
I use AI before I pass them to a real 2D Artist contractor for both character and environment. I treat it like a mockup on how I articulate my idea. The style is still far from my expectation, but it got the direction to support my text direction to the artist.

My learning processes:
- I learned how artist processes references and emulate their design processes with my AI assistants
- I do have experience in simple art creation; color blockout and structure sketch
- I do have prior experience in multi-passes SD 1.5 workflow before playing with GPT or Gemini
- I split structure, style, and render passes in general.
- I do inpainting in between passes. A lot.

If you still hoping stuff in single pass, you won't get anywhere near what you envision. Even with modern tool like GPT/Gemini, you still need to do at least those 3 passes, though how the prompt goes is very different.

comments.author: BugaiGames
comments.body:
Comfyui - experiment with loras/models/prompts to get style.
Than ask Claude to generate hundreds of images.
Review manually, pick what is good,  improve Claude prompt, repeat.
Recommend to build custom tool for review generated asseta.
More over sometimes AI fails to generate asset you need and you can waste hours and days with no result. To combat that, where possible use "porn games method". First generate assets that are good and than add them as characters and build game around, not other way

comments.body: for game character design, ComfyUI with IP-Adapter lets you lock a face across poses locally. Mage Space keeps characters consistant across scenes without the local setup if thats the blocker for you.
